Braemar, in turn, has been forced to expend significant time and capital to defend itself. Mr. Said’s checkered past, his hospitality sector acquisition ambitions and his repeated efforts to gain influence at Braemar run counter to the best interests of all shareholders. In its latest effort to undermine the Company, Al Shams filed a Rule 202 Discovery Petition (a “202 Petition”) seeking to depose two former Braemar directors before determining whether there is even a need to depose them.
